name: deskcalc-verify
description: A human checks and confirms the figures an AI extracted - in DeskCalc, before the AI relies on the total.
long_description: The AI hands the amounts it read from invoices, receipts, bank statements or tables to DeskCalc as a labelled tape. You check every line, correct what is wrong and press Confirm in DeskCalc; only then does the AI get the confirmed total, your corrections and a check of the printed figures to the cent. Checks VAT, quantity x price, discounts, mixed VAT rates, carry-overs, cross-footing and foreign currency; saves an audit record as PDF. Runs locally: no network connection, no account, no telemetry. Requires Windows and DeskCalc 11.3 or later.
